SELECT DISTINCT e.book_id, e.book_title, e.author, e.cover_img, c.category_name, e.price, e.rating, e.rating_count, o.create_time AS purchase_time, o.order_id, rp.last_read_time, rp.file_format AS last_read_format, rp.last_position, CASE WHEN rp.progress_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_reading_progress, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ef.file_format) AS available_formats FROM tb_ebook e INNER JOIN tb_order_item oi ON e.book_id = oi.book_id INNER JOIN tb_order o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN tb_category c ON e.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN tb_reading_progress rp ON e.book_id = rp.book_id AND rp.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN tb_ebook_file ef ON e.book_id = ef.book_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.pay_status = 1 AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND e.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY e.book_id, o.order_id, rp.last_read_time, rp.file_format, rp.last_position, rp.progress_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN rp.last_read_time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, rp.last_read_time DESC, o.create_time DESC
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC
ORDER BY e.book_title ASC
ORDER BY CASE WHEN rp.last_read_time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, rp.last_read_time DESC, o.create_time DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.book_id) FROM tb_ebook e INNER JOIN tb_order_item oi ON e.book_id = oi.book_id INNER JOIN tb_order o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.pay_status = 1 AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND e.is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM tb_order o INNER JOIN tb_order_item oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND oi.book_id = #{bookId} AND o.pay_status = 1 AND o.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_reading_progress (user_id, book_id, file_format, last_position, last_read_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookId}, #{fileFormat}, #{lastPosition}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT(user_id, book_id, file_format) DO UPDATE SET last_position = excluded.last_position, last_read_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT file_format FROM tb_ebook_file WHERE book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY file_format
